name: Kenvi Jewels Limited
summary: Kenvi Jewels Ltd., an Indian enterprise established on June 24, 2013, with its headquarters in Ahmedabad, specializes in the production, wholesale distribution, retail sale, and overall trade of gold and various jewelry items. The company boasts a comprehensive collection that caters to diverse tastes, featuring pieces for weddings and festive celebrations, alongside a wide range of everyday adornments such as rings, chains, earrings, ear chains, nose rings/pins, waist belts, traditional mangalsutras, anklets, zudas, toe rings, pendant sets, individual pendants, bracelets, and bangles.
